Linux slicing compatibility not yet verified (this release segfaults on macOS — see entry notes).

MacOs.notes: Newest working macOS build — 2.3.2 through 2.4.2 segfault here (see entry notes).

slicers.notes: Versions 2.3.2 through 2.4.2 were observed to segfault (SIGSEGV, exit 139) on macOS in Print::apply() -> update_values_to_printer_extruders_for_multiple_filaments when machine and process settings are loaded together via --load-settings, reproduced with unmodified shipped presets, so macOS (and Windows) stay on 2.3.1. The crash is in shared slicing-core code. The upstream repository is OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer (previously SoftFever/OrcaSlicer).

"version" is the maintainer-chosen display string (FR-005), not the literal upstream release tag — Bambu Studio's actual tag/asset-embedded string for this build is "02.07.01.57"; "2.7.1" is how Bambu markets it and is what users will see. The download URLs below are explicit literals and don't depend on this field matching the tag. Note: Bambu Studio 2.7.1's macOS CLI was independently confirmed during the OrcaSlicer 2.3.2 investigation to crash the same way (same shared PrusaSlicer-derived codebase) on the equivalent machine+process combination — not yet re-pinned to an older version because no working Bambu Studio version has been bisected yet; treat it as similarly suspect.
